dimensions.assessment: Affects NTIA personnel, telecommunications and technology market stakeholders, small businesses, and rural communications providers.
dimensions.evidence: There shall be within the NTIA an office to be known as the Office of Policy Development and Cybersecurity

dimensions.assessment: Reorganizes an office within the NTIA and formalizes policy duties related to cybersecurity, innovation, and digital access without creating new direct mandates for the public.
dimensions.evidence: The position of Associate Administrator for Policy Analysis and Development at the NTIA is hereby redesignated as the position of Associate Administrator for Policy Development and Cybersecurity

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific funding allocations or budget changes.
Amends the National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act to establish a new office and outline detailed duties.
dimensions.evidence: Part A of the National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act (47 U.S.C. 901 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent organizational structure and statutory mandate.

missing_information: Staffing levels or operational budgets assigned to the new office.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes the Office of Policy Development and Cybersecurity within the NTIA, redesignating an existing position and assigning specific internet and communications technology policy duties.
